powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Restricted -Command 
                        $Res = 0
                        $InboxIMEs = (@(
                          '{0000897b-83df-4b96-be07-0fb58b01c4a4}','{03b5835f-f03c-411b-9ce2-aa23e1171e36}',
                          '{531fdebf-9b4c-4a43-a2aa-960e8fcdc732}','{6a498709-e00b-4c45-a018-8f9e4081ae40}',

                          '{81ea0a17-aa39-455b-ba20-ea79a8f98966}','{8613e14c-d0c0-4161-ac0f-1dd2563286bc}',
                          '{a028ae76-01b1-46c2-99c4-acd9858ae02f}','{a1e2b86b-924a-4d43-80f6-8a820df7190f}',
                          '{b115690a-ea02-48d5-a231-e3578d2fdf80}','{c2cb2cf0-af47-413e-9780-8bc3a3c16068}',
                          '{dcbd6fa8-032f-11d3-b5b1-00c04fc324a1}','{e429b25a-e5d3-4d1f-9be3-0c608477e3a1}',
                          '{f25e9f57-2fc8-4eb3-a41a-cce5f08541e6}','{fa445657-9379-11d6-b41a-00065b83ee53}'
                        ) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join '|'
                        $InboxPattern = 'TIP\\(?:' + $InboxIMEs + ')'
                        $LanguageProfiles = Get-Item 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\CTF\TIP\{????????-????-????-????-????????????}\LanguageProfile\0x*\{????????-????-????-????-????????????}' -EA SilentlyContinue
                        foreach ($prof in @($LanguageProfiles)) {
                          if ($prof.PSPath -match $InboxPattern) { continue }
                          $pp = Get-ItemProperty $prof.PSPath -EA SilentlyContinue
                          $hasEnable = ($pp.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Enable')
                          if ((-not $hasEnable) -or ($pp.Enable -eq 1)) {
                            $Res = 1
                            break
                          }
                        }
                        Write-Host 'Final result:',$Res
